verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents that powers of attorney (Vollmachten) can be filed electronically with the tax office, which is a sanctioned way to authorize a representative. It also lets organisations name Postfachvertreter (mailbox representatives) to view inbox messages. ELSTER-supported third-party tax software can transmit through the same channel, but that is a software route, not a designee acting for the company. Missing for 10: detail on how an authorized provider (e.g., a tax advisor) actually acts and files on the company's behalf, what scope the delegated authority covers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
